verdict.rationale: Mem0 docs explicitly describe an open-source self-hosted bundle ('same memory engine as the Platform, running on your own infrastructure') delivered as a Docker stack with REST API, dashboard, per-user API keys, and audit log, giving platform engineers full infra control. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the Docker deployment working in practice and details on infra requirements (e.g., DB/vector store provisioning) beyond first-party docs.
